podcast.title: First Commercial CD Release (1982)
podcast.body: On August 17, 1982, Claudio Arrau's performance of Chopin waltzes became the first commercial compact disk ever produced. Arrau was personally invited to the German pressing plant to press the start button for the manufacturing of his disks, marking a historic moment for the new format. `"The first commercial compact disk was produced on August 17, 1982. It was Claudio Arral, performing some Chopin waltzes."`

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Portable Music: Part 1

podcast.title: First Public Consumption CD (August 17, 1982)
podcast.body: Claudia Arrau's performance of some Chopin waltzes was the first compact disc produced for public consumption, coming off the production line on August 17, 1982. "The first CD to be produced for public consumption was another classical work, some wallets by Chopin performed by Claudia Aroh. It came off the line on August 17, 1982."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
